name: Session Closed - Negative Sentiment
_comment: Illustrative sketch of the N8n workflow. N8n ORCHESTRATES (trigger, routing, retry, DLQ); the business logic lives in the Lambda. The transcript reaches N8n ALREADY encrypted (item c).

nodes.name: Trigger - Session Closed (SQS/Webhook)
nodes.notes: Receives the session closed event. Could also be an EventBridge webhook. Payload has session_id, customer_id, sentiment, transcript_ciphertext (encrypted).

nodes.name: IF - Negative Sentiment?
nodes.notes: Routes only when sentiment == 'negative'. Neutral/positive sentiment ends the flow at no cost.

nodes.name: Lambda - Session Handler
nodes.notes: Invokes lambda_session_handler.py SYNCHRONOUSLY. The Lambda runs the 3 side effects (S3, CRM, SNS), each idempotent. Retry: 3x with exponential backoff. Timeout aligned with the Lambda.

nodes.name: On Error - Send to DLQ
nodes.notes: If the Lambda still fails after the retries, publishes the event (with session_id) to an SQS DLQ for manual or automatic reprocessing. The event is never lost.
